# Fresh-Cut Landscaping LLC

> Professional landscaping, mulching, tree trimming & removal, gutter cleaning, leaf removal, junk removal, and storm damage cleanup serving Fredericksburg, Stafford, Spotsylvania, Culpeper, Woodbridge, and King George, Virginia.

## Business Info
- Owner: Alex M. (owner-operated)
- Phone: 540-455-7405
- Location: Fredericksburg, VA (serves Virginia's 540 area code)
- Rating: 4.9 stars on Google
- Hours: Mon-Fri 7am-6pm, Sat 8am-4pm
- Languages: English, Spanish (Guia en Espanol available)

## Services
- Landscaping & Lawn Design
- Mulching (bulk mulch installation, bed prep, edging)
- Tree Trimming & Removal (certified, safe removal of hazardous trees)
- Gutter Cleaning (debris removal, downspout flush, inspection)
- Leaf Removal (fall/spring cleanup, bed clearing)
- Junk Removal (yard debris, furniture, appliance hauling)
- Storm Damage Cleanup (24-48 hour emergency response)
- Power Washing (driveways, patios, siding, decks)
- Lawn Aeration (core aeration for compacted Virginia clay soils)
- Recurring Maintenance Plans (weekly, bi-weekly, monthly)

## Service Area
Fredericksburg, Stafford, Spotsylvania, Culpeper, Woodbridge, King George, and surrounding Virginia communities in the 540 area code.

## Key Differentiators
- Owner-operated (Alex personally oversees every job)
- Free estimates with no obligation
- Same-day and next-day service available
- Storm damage treated as priority (24-48 hour response)
- Seasonal maintenance plans available
- Bilingual team (English and Spanish)
- Licensed and insured
- No contracts required for one-time services

## FAQ
- Q: Do you offer free estimates? A: Yes, always free with no obligation. Call 540-455-7405 or use the instant estimate form online.
- Q: What areas do you serve? A: Fredericksburg, Stafford, Spotsylvania, Culpeper, Woodbridge, King George, and surrounding areas.
- Q: Do you handle storm damage? A: Yes. We treat storm damage as priority with 24-48 hour response times.
- Q: Are you licensed and insured? A: Yes, fully licensed and insured for all services.
- Q: Do you speak Spanish? A: Yes, our team is bilingual (English/Spanish). We have a Spanish guide at fresh-cut-landscape.com/guia.html.
- Q: Do you require contracts? A: No contracts for one-time services. Recurring maintenance plans are flexible.
- Q: What is your cancellation policy? A: We ask for 24-hour notice for appointment changes.
